_source: Zambian OBC 2013 Religious Education (2044), Grade 12 — subject code 'RE2044'. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 (superseding this file's earlier same-day version, which had real topic/sub-topic detail but no real week/term placement) using a real, complete Google Drive document, 'RE 2044 SCHEMES OF WORK 10-12.docx', from a real Zambian secondary school — a genuine week-by-week Scheme of Work covering all three grades and terms. Real PII stripped, per standing sourcing policy: the document's final line credited a real named individual and named the source school/town/province; none of that appears anywhere in this file — the school's identity is deliberately not recorded. Topic-level names ('Man's Evasion from God', 'The Search for God') and their real Term 1/Term 2 placement now come from this document, cross-confirming and dating the sub-topic-level detail this file already had (built earlier the same day from a different real document, a Grade 11 Term 3 'preview' of this same content, whose own sub-topic breakdown split slightly differently — this file keeps the earlier, more granular 5+3 sub-topic breakdown and layers real week numbers from this newer, more authoritative source onto it, rather than replacing it). 'Family Life' (Grade 11's own topic) genuinely continues into this grade's Term 1 in the source before 'Man's Evasion from God' begins — a real cross-grade continuation, not duplicated here (see religious_education_2044_grade11.json). Term 3 in the source is entirely CAT/revision of every prior topic (Grade 10 through Grade 12) ahead of the School Certificate Examination — introduces no new content of its own, so it is not represented as a term entry here, consistent with how Grade 11's own Term 3 revision content was handled.

curriculum.name: 2013 Outcome-Based Curriculum
curriculum.description: Zambia's 2013 outcome-based curriculum for Grades 10-12 (Senior Secondary).

subject.name: Religious Education (2044)
subject.description: Senior Secondary Religious Education (2044) syllabus, Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013) — a distinct edition from the 2046 syllabus already bundled under subject code 'RE'.

sub_topics.name: Evasion in Modern Zambian Society
sub_topics.description: Discuss man's evasion from God in modern Zambian society, e.g. materialism, evasion in Islam.
sub_topics.references: Grade 12 book pg 51-53; R.E Grade 10-12 book pg 122-123; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 1-3

sub_topics.name: Evasion in African Society
sub_topics.description: Explain evasion in African traditional society, e.g. magic, divination, charms, witchcraft.
sub_topics.references: Grades 10-12 book pg 125-127; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 7-10; Grade 12 book pg 56-59

sub_topics.name: Evasion in the Church
sub_topics.description: State evasion of God in the church, e.g. divisions, immorality, idolatry.
sub_topics.references: R.E. Grades 10-12 book pg 130-131; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 11-16; Grade 12 book pg 60-61

sub_topics.name: Evasion in the Old Testament
sub_topics.description: Describe evasion in the Old Testament (Isaiah 40:21-26; Isaiah 1:10-17; Ezekiel 28:1-10; Psalm 53:1-6).
sub_topics.references: Grades 10-12 bk pg 131-132; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 17-18; Good News Bible; Grade 12 bk pg 62

sub_topics.name: Evasion in the New Testament
sub_topics.description: State teachings on evasion in the New Testament (Luke 12:13-21; Luke 16:19-31; Matthew 4:1-11; Matthew 7:7-11).
sub_topics.references: Grade 10-12 bk pg 133-134; Good News Bible; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 19-21; Grade 12 bk pg 63

sub_topics.name: The Search for God in the Present Situation
sub_topics.description: Describe the search for God in Zambian society today, e.g. prayer, scriptures, Hinduism and Islam.
sub_topics.references: Grade 12 book pg 27-29; R.E Grade 10-12 book pg 136-137; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 22-26

sub_topics.name: The Search for God in African Tradition
sub_topics.description: Identify teachings on God in African tradition, e.g. attributes of God, traditional religious rituals, spirits of the ancestors.
sub_topics.references: Grades 10-12 book pg 137-140; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 30-36; Grade 12 book pg 34-38

sub_topics.name: The Search for God in the Church
sub_topics.description: Explain the search for God in the early church, e.g. moral reformers, philosophers, those attracted to sects, the role of the church.
sub_topics.references: R.E. Grades 10-12 book pg 143-146; Senior Secondary Religious Studies (2044) pg 37-41; Grade 12 book pg 39-43
